docs.title: Products Carousel Section
docs.text:
The Products Carousel section allows you to showcase a selection of products in a beautiful sliding carousel. This is perfect for featuring best-sellers, new arrivals, sale items, or any curated collection of products you want to highlight.

Use this section to: - Feature hand-picked products on your homepage - Showcase bestsellers or new arrivals - Highlight products on sale - Create themed product collections

docs.title: Adding and Managing This Section
docs.text: This is a flexible section that can be added to most pages in your store. To learn how to add, remove, or reorder sections on your page, please refer to Shopify's official guide on Using sections and blocks.

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
• Color scheme — Choose the color scheme for this section's background and text. Default: Scheme 2.
  • Margin top — Control the top margin (space above the section). Choose between Standard or None.
  • Margin bottom — Control the bottom margin (space below the section). Choose between Standard or None.
  • Padding top — Control the internal top padding within the section. Choose between Standard or None.
  • Padding bottom — Control the internal bottom padding within the section. Choose between Standard or None.

docs.title: Background
docs.text:
• Section type — Choose whether the section spans the full width or stays within a container:
  • Container — Section background stays within the content area
  • Full width — Section background extends edge-to-edge
  • Section height — Choose how the section height is determined:
  • Auto — Section height adjusts automatically based on content
  • Fixed — Section has a fixed height
  • Section background height — When using fixed height, control what percentage of the viewport the section fills. Range: 0-100%. Default: 80%. (Only visible when section height is set to Fixed)

docs.title: Section Settings
docs.text: • Product list — Select up to 20 specific products to display in this carousel. Click to search and select products from your store. You can reorder products by dragging and dropping them in the list.

docs.title: Slider Settings
docs.text:
Control how the product carousel behaves:

  • Slides per view (desktop) — How many products to show at once on desktop. Options: 3, 4, 5, or 6 products. Default: 4.
  • Slides per view (tablet) — How many products to show on tablets. Options: 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, or Automatic. Default: 3.
  • Slides per view (phone) — How many products to show on phones. Options: 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, or Automatic. Default: 1.5. (Decimal values like 1.5 show one full product plus a partial peek of the next)
  • Slider pagination bullets — Enable to show navigation dots below the carousel. Default: Disabled.
  • Alternate image offset — When enabled, every other product card will be offset downward, creating a staggered visual effect. Default: Disabled.
  • Carousel outside container — When enabled, the carousel extends beyond the container width, allowing cards to peek from the sides. Default: Enabled.

docs.title: Text Settings
docs.text:
Options for the introductory text that appears above the products:

  • Text alignment — Choose Left, Center, or Right alignment for the heading and content. Default: Center.
  • Heading — The main heading text that introduces your product carousel. Default: "Example heading".
  • Select the HTML tag for the heading — Choose the HTML tag for SEO purposes (H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, or span). This doesn't affect the visual size. Default: H2.
  • Heading size — Choose how large the heading appears visually. This doesn't affect the HTML tag, only the size shown to visitors. Default: H2-size.
  • Heading font-weight — Choose between Normal or Bold. Default: Bold.
  • Content — Add descriptive text or a paragraph below the heading. Supports rich text formatting.

docs.title: Button
docs.text:
Add an optional button below your section heading:

  • Button text — The text shown on the button. Leave empty to hide the button. Default: "Learn more".
  • Link — Where the button should navigate when clicked.
  • Button icon — Add an optional icon to the button (None, Chevron Right, Arrow Circle Right, or Arrow Right).
  • Secondary button style — Enable to style the button as an outlined secondary button instead of a solid primary button. Default: Disabled.

docs.title: Button 2
docs.text:
Add an optional second button:

  • Button 2 text — The text for the second button. Leave empty to hide it.
  • Link — Where the second button should navigate.
  • Button 2 icon — Add an optional icon to the second button.
  • Secondary button style — Enable to style button 2 as an outlined button. Default: Enabled.

docs.title: Blocks
docs.text: This section does not use blocks. Instead, products are selected directly in the Product list setting.

docs.title: Usage Tips
docs.text:
• Product selection: Choose products that complement each other or share a theme (e.g., all winter collection, all products under $50, etc.).
  • Mobile experience: Showing 1.5 or 2.5 products on mobile helps customers understand they can swipe to see more.
  • Product cards: The appearance of the product cards is controlled by the global Product Cards settings in your theme settings. Adjust those settings to change how products look throughout your entire store.
  • Call to action: Use the button to link to a collection page or other relevant destination where customers can see more products.

docs.title: Need Help?
docs.text: For more information about working with sections in Shopify themes, visit Shopify's Help Center.

docs.title: Products Grid Section
docs.text:
The Products Grid section displays a curated selection of products in a clean, organized grid layout. Unlike the Products Carousel, this section shows all products at once in rows and columns, making it perfect for featuring collections or themed product groups.

Use this section to: - Showcase hand-picked products in a grid format - Feature bestsellers, new arrivals, or sale items - Create themed product displays - Display products without requiring scrolling

docs.title: Adding and Managing This Section
docs.text: This section can be added to most pages in your store. To learn how to add, remove, or reorder sections on your page, please refer to Shopify's official guide on Using sections and blocks.

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
• Color scheme — Choose the color scheme for this section's background and text. Default: Scheme 1.
  • Margin top — Control the top margin (space above the section). Choose between Standard or None.
  • Margin bottom — Control the bottom margin (space below the section). Choose between Standard or None.
  • Padding top — Control the internal top padding within the section. Choose between Standard or None.
  • Padding bottom — Control the internal bottom padding within the section. Choose between Standard or None.

docs.title: Content
docs.text: • Product list — Select up to 20 specific products to display in the grid. Click to search and select products from your store. You can reorder products by dragging and dropping them in the list.

docs.title: Text Settings
docs.text:
• Text alignment — Choose Left, Center, or Right alignment for the heading and content. Default: Center.
  • Heading — The main heading text that introduces your product grid. Default: "Example heading".
  • Heading tag — Choose the HTML tag for SEO purposes (H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, or span). This doesn't affect the visual size. Default: H2.
  • Heading size — Choose how large the heading appears visually (H1-size through Title 2-size). This doesn't affect the HTML tag, only the size. Default: H2-size.
  • Heading font-weight — Choose between Normal or Bold. Default: Bold.
  • Content — Add descriptive text or a paragraph below the heading. Supports rich text formatting.

docs.title: Button
docs.text:
Add an optional primary button below your section heading:

  • Button text — The text shown on the button. Leave empty to hide the button. Default: "Learn more".
  • Link — Where the button should navigate when clicked. (Only visible when button text is provided)
  • Secondary button style — Enable to style the button as an outlined button instead of a solid button. Default: Disabled. (Only visible when button text is provided)
  • Button icon — Add an optional icon to the button (None, Chevron Right, Arrow Circle Right, or Arrow Right). (Only visible when button text is provided)

docs.title: Button 2
docs.text:
Add an optional second button:

  • Button 2 text — The text for the second button. Leave empty to hide it. Default: "Another button".
  • Link — Where the second button should navigate. (Only visible when button 2 text is provided)
  • Secondary button style — Enable to style button 2 as an outlined button. Default: Enabled. (Only visible when button 2 text is provided)
  • Button 2 icon — Add an optional icon to the second button. (Only visible when button 2 text is provided)

docs.title: Blocks
docs.text: This section does not use blocks. Products are selected directly in the Product list setting.

docs.title: Usage Tips
docs.text:
• Grid vs. Carousel: Use the grid when you want to show all products at once without requiring interaction. Use the Products Carousel when you have many products and want to save vertical space.

  • Product count: The grid automatically adjusts the number of columns based on how many products you select and the screen size. On desktop, products typically display in 3-4 columns.

  • Product selection: Choose products that complement each other or share a theme. For example, "Summer Essentials" or "Products Under $50."

  • Product cards: The appearance of the product cards is controlled by the global Product Cards settings in your theme settings. This includes what information displays, hover effects, and badges.

  • Call to action: Use the button to link to a full collection page where customers can browse more products.

  • Mobile layout: Products automatically adjust to 1-2 columns on mobile devices for optimal viewing.

docs.title: Need Help?
docs.text: For more information about working with sections in Shopify themes, visit Shopify's Help Center.

docs.title: Testimonials Section
docs.text:
The Testimonials section lets you showcase customer reviews and feedback in an engaging slider format. Social proof is powerful — displaying positive testimonials helps build trust and encourages new customers to make purchases.

Use this section to: - Display customer reviews and feedback - Build trust with social proof - Highlight positive customer experiences - Showcase 5-star ratings - Feature customer quotes on your homepage

docs.title: Adding and Managing This Section
docs.text: This section can be added to index (homepage) and page templates. To learn how to add, remove, or reorder sections on your page, please refer to Shopify's official guide on Using sections and blocks.

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
• Color scheme — Choose the color scheme for this section's background and text. Default: Scheme 2.
  • Section type — Choose the section width:
  • Container — Section stays within the content area
  • Full width — Section extends edge-to-edge

Default: Container. * Margin top — Control the top margin. Choose between Auto or None. * Margin bottom — Control the bottom margin. Choose between Auto or None. * Padding top — Control the internal top padding. Choose between Auto or None. * Padding bottom — Control the internal bottom padding. Choose between Auto or None.

docs.title: Slider Settings
docs.text:
Control how the testimonials carousel behaves:

  • Slides per view (desktop) — How many testimonials to show at once on desktop. Options: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, or Automatic. Default: 3.
  • Slides per view (tablet) — How many testimonials to show on tablets. Options: 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, or Automatic. Default: 2.5.
  • Slides per view (phone) — How many testimonials to show on phones. Options: 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 4, or Automatic. Default: 1.5.
  • Slider pagination bullets — Enable to show navigation dots below the carousel. Default: Disabled.
  • Alternate image offset — When enabled, every other testimonial card will be offset downward for visual interest. Default: Disabled.
  • Carousel outside container — When enabled, the carousel extends beyond the container width. Default: Enabled.

docs.title: Text Settings
docs.text:
Options for the introductory text above the testimonials:

  • Text alignment — Choose Left, Center, or Right. Default: Center.
  • Heading — The main heading for this section. Default: "Example heading".
  • Heading tag — Choose the HTML tag for SEO (H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, or span). Default: H2.
  • Heading size — Choose the visual size (H1-size through Title 2-size). Default: H2-size.
  • Heading font-weight — Choose Normal or Bold. Default: Bold.
  • Content — Add descriptive text below the heading. Supports rich text.

docs.title: Button
docs.text:
Add an optional button:

  • Button text — The text shown on the button. Leave empty to hide. Default: "Learn more".
  • Link — Where the button navigates. (Only visible when button text is provided)
  • Secondary button style — Enable for an outlined button style. Default: Disabled. (Only visible when button text is provided)
  • Button icon — Add an optional icon. (Only visible when button text is provided)

docs.title: Button 2
docs.text:
Add an optional second button:

  • Button 2 text — The text for the second button. Leave empty to hide.
  • Link — Where button 2 navigates. (Only visible when button 2 text is provided)
  • Secondary button style — Enable for an outlined button style. Default: Enabled. (Only visible when button 2 text is provided)
  • Button 2 icon — Add an optional icon. (Only visible when button 2 text is provided)

docs.title: Review Block
docs.text:
Add individual testimonials as review blocks. Each block represents one customer testimonial.

Settings: * Rating — Select the star rating for this review (1-5 stars). Default: 5 stars. * Customer Name — The name of the customer giving the testimonial. Default: "John Doe". * Review Content — The testimonial text. Share what the customer said about your product or service. Supports rich text formatting.

docs.title: ISM App Block
docs.text:
This special block integrates with the InStijl Media reviews app. You can only add one of these blocks.

Settings: * Maximum review length — Control how long reviews can be before they're truncated. Range: 30-250 characters. Default: 100 characters.

Note: This block requires the InStijl Media reviews app to be installed and configured.

docs.title: Usage Tips
docs.text:
• Authentic testimonials: Use real customer feedback whenever possible. Authentic testimonials are more convincing than generic praise.

  • Mix testimonials: Include a variety of testimonials that highlight different aspects of your business (product quality, customer service, shipping, etc.).

  • Star ratings: Always include star ratings when available — they provide quick visual proof of satisfaction.

  • Keep it concise: Shorter testimonials are more likely to be read. If you have a long review, use the most compelling excerpt.

  • Include names: Testimonials with real names (and optionally photos) are more trustworthy than anonymous reviews.

  • Strategic placement: This section works great near the top of your homepage or on landing pages where you need to build credibility quickly.

  • Call to action: Use the button to link to a full reviews page, product page, or encourage visitors to become customers.

docs.title: Need Help?
docs.text: For more information about working with sections in Shopify themes, visit Shopify's Help Center.

docs.title: Theme Settings
docs.text:
This guide explains all the global settings for your Theme InSpire. These settings control the overall appearance and behavior of your entire online store. You can access these settings by going to your Shopify admin, clicking on Online Store > Themes, and then clicking the Customize button on your active theme.

Once in the Theme Editor, click the theme settings icon (usually in the left sidebar) to access these global options.

docs.title: Logo
docs.text: Configure your store's logo and favicon (the small icon that appears in browser tabs).

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
• Logo — Upload your store's logo image. This will appear in your header and throughout your store.
  • Logo width — Control how wide your logo appears on your site. You can adjust this from 50px to 300px. The default is 100px.
  • Favicon — Upload a small icon (favicon) that will appear in browser tabs when customers visit your store. Your image will automatically be resized to 32x32 pixels.

docs.title: Colors
docs.text: Control the color schemes used throughout your store. You can create multiple color schemes and apply them to different sections.

docs.title: Color Schemes
docs.text:
You can define multiple color schemes (combinations of colors that work well together). Each scheme includes:

  • Background color — The main background color for sections using this scheme.
  • Background gradient — Add a gradient effect to the background. This will replace the solid background color if you set one.
  • Title color — The color used for headings and titles.
  • Text color — The color used for body text and paragraphs.
  • Button background — The background color for primary buttons.
  • Button text color — The text color that appears on primary buttons.
  • Secondary outlined button color — The color used for secondary (outline-style) buttons, including their text and border.

docs.title: Global Color Settings
docs.text:
• Default color scheme — Select which color scheme to use as the default throughout your store.
  • Body text color — The main color for regular text across your site.
  • Default background color — The background color for your site when no specific scheme is applied.
  • Link text color — The color for clickable text links.
  • Color for borders — The color used for borders and dividing lines throughout your site.
  • Error color — The color used to display error messages (default: red).
  • Warning color — The color used for warning messages (default: yellow/orange).
  • Success color — The color used for success messages (default: green).
  • Informational color — The color used for informational messages (default: blue).

docs.title: Typography
docs.text: Control all the fonts and text sizes used throughout your store.

docs.title: Font Selection
docs.text:
• Heading font — Choose the font family for all headings (H1, H2, H3, etc.) across your store.
  • Body font — Choose the font family for regular body text throughout your store.

docs.title: Font Sizes - Desktop
docs.text:
Set the size of text for different heading levels when viewed on desktop computers:

  • H1 font size — Size for your largest headings. Range: 10-50px. Default: 36px.
  • H2 font size — Size for secondary headings. Range: 10-50px. Default: 32px.
  • H3 font size — Size for third-level headings. Range: 10-100px. Default: 24px.
  • H4 font size — Size for fourth-level headings. Range: 10-100px. Default: 20px.
  • H5 font size — Size for fifth-level headings. Range: 10-100px. Default: 16px.
  • H6 font size — Size for your smallest headings. Range: 10-100px. Default: 14px.
  • Title 1 font size — Size for display titles (extra large decorative text). Range: 10-50px. Default: 48px.
  • Title 2 font size — Size for secondary display titles. Range: 10-50px. Default: 40px.
  • Body font size — Size for regular paragraph text. Range: 10-30px. Default: 16px.

docs.title: Font Sizes - Mobile and Tablet
docs.text:
Set the size of text when viewed on mobile phones and tablets:

  • H1 font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-50px. Default: 28px.
  • H2 font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-50px. Default: 24px.
  • H3 font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-50px. Default: 20px.
  • H4 font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-50px. Default: 18px.
  • H5 font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-50px. Default: 16px.
  • H6 font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-50px. Default: 14px.
  • Title 1 font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-50px. Default: 36px.
  • Title 2 font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-50px. Default: 32px.
  • Body font size (mobile/tablet) — Range: 10-30px. Default: 14px.

docs.title: Font Settings
docs.text:
Fine-tune the spacing and appearance of your text:

  • Heading letter spacing — Adjust the space between letters in headings. Use negative values to tighten spacing or positive values to loosen it. Range: -5px to 10px. Default: 0px.
  • Heading line height — Control the vertical space between lines in headings. Higher values create more breathing room. Range: 1 to 2. Default: 1.2.
  • Body letter spacing — Adjust the space between letters in body text. Range: -5px to 10px. Default: 0px.
  • Body line height — Control the vertical space between lines in body text. Higher values improve readability. Range: 1 to 2. Default: 1.8.

docs.title: Layout & Styling
docs.text: Control the overall layout, spacing, and visual style of your store.

docs.title: Container Width
docs.text: • Container width — Set the maximum width of your content area. Range: 1100-1800px. Default: 1300px. Larger values create a wider site, while smaller values create a more compact design.

docs.title: Border Radius
docs.text:
Control how rounded the corners are for different elements:

Sections: * Section border radius — How rounded the corners of sections should be. Range: 0-100px. Default: 30px. * Section radius top — Which top corners should be rounded (None / Both / Left / Right). * Section radius bottom — Which bottom corners should be rounded (None / Both / Left / Right).

Cards (Product cards, collection cards, etc.): * Card border radius — How rounded the corners of cards should be. Range: 0-30px. Default: 20px. * Card radius top — Which top corners should be rounded (None / Both / Left / Right). * Card radius bottom — Which bottom corners should be rounded (None / Both / Left / Right).

Buttons: * Button border radius — How rounded button corners should be. Range: 0-30px. Default: 30px. * Button radius top — Which top corners should be rounded (None / Both / Left / Right). * Button radius bottom — Which bottom corners should be rounded (None / Both / Left / Right).

docs.title: Shadows
docs.text:
• Card Shadows — Control when shadows appear on cards:
  • None — No shadows
  • On hover — Shadows only appear when you hover over a card
  • Always — Shadows are always visible

docs.title: Animation
docs.text: • Enable entrance animations — When enabled, elements will animate into view as customers scroll down the page. This creates a more dynamic, engaging experience. Note: These animations won't be visible when viewing your site in the Theme Editor.

docs.title: Header
docs.text:
Configure how your header (the top bar of your site) appears.

  • Transparent header — Enable this to make the header transparent on your homepage. The header will use the normal background when you scroll down. This works best when your first homepage section is a full-width banner or carousel.
  • Header text color — Choose the color for text and icons when the header is transparent. This ensures your navigation is visible over your homepage hero image. (Only visible when "Transparent header" is enabled)
  • Logo for transparent header — Upload an alternate logo that only shows when the header is transparent. For example, you might use a white logo on the transparent header and your regular colored logo when scrolled. (Only visible when "Transparent header" is enabled)

docs.title: Sections
docs.text: Control the spacing between and within sections throughout your store.

docs.title: General - Desktop
docs.text:
Control spacing on desktop computers:

  • Space Within — The padding (internal space) inside sections. This is the space between the section's border and its content. Range: 0-100px. Default: 30px.
  • Space between — The space between sections on all pages. Range: 0-100px. Default: 30px.

docs.title: Homepage - Desktop
docs.text: • Space Between homepage sections — Override the general spacing for sections on the homepage only. Use this if you want tighter or looser spacing on your homepage. Range: 0-100px. Default: 30px.

docs.title: General - Phone
docs.text:
Control spacing on mobile phones:

  • Space Within — The padding inside sections on mobile. Range: 0-100px. Default: 15px.
  • Space between — The space between sections on mobile. Range: 0-100px. Default: 0px.

docs.title: Homepage - Phone
docs.text: • Space between homepage sections — Override the general mobile spacing for sections on the homepage only. Range: 0-100px. Default: 0px.

docs.title: Product Cards
docs.text: These settings control how product cards look throughout your store (in collections, search results, product grids, etc.).

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
• Product card color scheme — Choose which color scheme to apply to all product cards.
  • Show border — Enable to show a border around each product card.
  • Text alignment — Choose how text is aligned within product cards (Left / Center / Right).

docs.title: Card Features
docs.text:
Choose which information to display on product cards:

  • Show vendor — Display the product's brand or vendor name.
  • Show reviews — Display product review stars (requires a reviews app).
  • Show title — Display the product name.
  • Show price — Display the product price.
  • Show add to cart button — Display a button to add the product to cart directly from the card.
  • Show number input — Display a quantity selector so customers can choose how many to add.
  • Show variants and options — Display product options (like size, color) directly on the card.

docs.title: Product Image
docs.text:
• Image Ratio — Control the shape of product images:
  • 1/1 (Square) — Square images
  • ¾ — Portrait (taller than wide)
  • 4/3 — Landscape (wider than tall)
  • 16/9 — Wide landscape
  • 9/16 — Tall portrait

docs.title: Product Title
docs.text:
• Title font-size — Choose the size for product titles (H1-size through Body-size). Default: H4-size.
  • Title font-weight — Choose Normal or Bold for product titles. Default: Normal.
  • Title position — Choose whether the title and price appear on one line together, or on separate lines.

docs.title: Product Price
docs.text:
• Price font-size — Choose the size for product prices (H1-size through Body-size). Default: H4-size.
  • Price font-weight — Choose Normal or Bold for product prices. Default: Bold.

docs.title: Hover Effects
docs.text:
Control what happens when customers hover over a product card:

  • Slightly zoom in on the product card on hover — The entire card will gently zoom when hovered.
  • Show cart options only on hover — The add to cart button and options only appear when hovering. This creates a cleaner look when not hovering.
  • Show a hover effect on product image — The product image will darken and blur slightly on hover, drawing attention to the card.

docs.title: Product Badges
docs.text:
Control the badges (labels) that appear on product cards:

General Badge Settings: * No rounded corners for badges — Disable this to make badges rectangular instead of rounded.

"New" Badge: * Show 'New' badge — Display a "New" badge on recently added products. * Number of days for 'New' badge — How many days after creation should a product show the "New" badge? Range: 1-60 days. Default: 14 days. * Icon for 'New' badge (optional) — Add an icon from Font Awesome (e.g., "star"). Visit https://fontawesome.com/v6/search for icon names. * Text for 'New' badge — Customize the text shown on the badge. Default: "New". * Background color 'New' badge — Choose the badge background color. Default: Green (#35D39D). * Text color 'New' badge — Choose the text color for the badge. Default: White.

"Sale" Badge: * Show 'Sale' badge — Display a "Sale" badge when a product has a compare-at price (is on sale). * Type 'Sale' badge — Choose whether to show text (like "Sale") or the discount percentage (like "-20%"). * Icon for 'Sale' badge (optional) — Add an icon from Font Awesome. * Text for 'Sale' badge — Customize the badge text. Default: "Sale". * Background color 'Sale' badge — Choose the badge background color. Default: Red (#EF4D61). * Text color 'Sale' badge — Choose the text color. Default: White.

Custom Badge (Advanced): * Show custom badge (metafield) — Enable badges controlled by product metafields. This requires setting up product metafields in your Shopify admin. * Icon for 'Custom' badge (optional) — Add an icon from Font Awesome. * Metafield name for custom badge — Enter the name of the product metafield to use (e.g., "custom_badge"). You must create this metafield in Shopify admin under Settings > Metafields > Products. * Color for custom badge — Choose the background color. Default: Yellow (#FFC12E). * Text color custom badge — Choose the text color. Default: White.

docs.title: Collection & Brand Cards
docs.text: Control how collection and brand cards appear throughout your store.

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
• Show collection/brand name — Display the name of the collection or brand on the card.
  • Show border — Display a border around collection and brand cards.

docs.title: Collection / Brand Image
docs.text:
• Image Ratio — Control the shape of images:
  • 1/1 (Square)
  • ¾ — Portrait
  • 4/3 — Landscape
  • 16/9 — Wide landscape
  • 9/16 — Tall portrait

docs.title: Hover Effects
docs.text: • Slightly zoom in on the collection/brand card on hover — Cards will gently zoom when customers hover over them.

docs.title: Hero Cards
docs.text: Hero cards are large banner-style cards often used to feature collections or promotions.

docs.title: Layout
docs.text:
• Title position — Choose where the title appears on the card:
  • Top — Title at the top of the card
  • Bottom — Title at the bottom of the card
  • Show border — Display a border around hero cards.

docs.title: Hover Effects
docs.text: • Slightly zoom in on the hero card on hover — Hero cards will gently zoom when hovered.

docs.title: Social Media
docs.text: Add links to your social media accounts. These links will appear in sections throughout your store (like your footer) wherever social media icons are enabled.

docs.title: Social Media Accounts
docs.text:
• X / Twitter account — Enter your X (Twitter) profile URL. Default: https://www.twitter.com/
  • Facebook account — Enter your Facebook page URL. Default: https://www.facebook.com/
  • Pinterest account — Enter your Pinterest profile URL. Default: https://www.pinterest.com/
  • Instagram account — Enter your Instagram profile URL. Default: https://www.instagram.com/
  • TikTok account — Enter your TikTok profile URL. Default: https://www.tiktok.com/
  • Snapchat account — Enter your Snapchat profile URL. Default: https://www.snapchat.com/
  • YouTube link — Enter your YouTube channel URL. Default: https://www.youtube.com/
  • LinkedIn link — Enter your LinkedIn profile or company page URL. Default: https://www.linkedin.com/

docs.title: Customization
docs.text: Questions about customizing your theme's appearance and settings.

docs.title: How do I change my logo?
docs.text:
1. Go to Online Store > Themes
  2. Click Customize
  3. Click Theme settings in the left sidebar
  4. Navigate to Logo
  5. Upload your logo image
  6. Adjust logo width if needed
  7. Click Save

docs.title: How do I change colors?
docs.text:
1. In the theme editor, click Theme settings
  2. Go to Colors
  3. Click on any color swatch to change it
  4. Choose your brand colors
  5. Click Save

docs.title: How do I change fonts?
docs.text:
1. In the theme editor, click Theme settings
  2. Go to Typography
  3. Select fonts for headings and body text
  4. Adjust font sizes if needed
  5. Click Save

docs.title: Can I add custom CSS?
docs.text: Yes. In the theme editor: 1. Click Theme settings 2. Scroll to Custom CSS 3. Add your CSS code 4. Click Save

docs.title: How many sections can I add to a page?
docs.text: Shopify allows up to 25 sections per template. You can add multiple blocks within each section.

docs.title: How do I edit my homepage?
docs.text:
1. Go to Online Store > Themes
  2. Click Customize
  3. Select Home from the page dropdown
  4. Add, remove, or rearrange sections
  5. Click Save

See our Homepage Setup Guide for detailed instructions.

docs.title: How do I add a slideshow/carousel?
docs.text:
1. In the theme editor, click Add section
  2. Select Image Carousel or Products Carousel
  3. Add your slides or products
  4. Configure carousel settings
  5. Click Save

docs.title: Can I create multiple homepage layouts?
docs.text: Shopify allows one homepage template, but you can create different page layouts using sections and save them as presets.

docs.title: Features & Functionality
docs.text: Questions about theme features and what the theme supports.

docs.title: Does Theme InSpire support multiple languages?
docs.text: Yes! Theme InSpire is translation-ready. You can: - Use Shopify's built-in language editor - Install translation apps from the Shopify App Store - Manually edit locale files

docs.title: Does Theme InSpire work with apps?
docs.text: Yes! Theme InSpire is compatible with most Shopify apps.

docs.title: Is Theme InSpire mobile-responsive?
docs.text: Yes! Theme InSpire is fully responsive and optimized for all devices including smartphones, tablets, and desktops.

docs.title: Does Theme InSpire support product videos?
docs.text: Yes! You can add videos to product pages by uploading them in the product media section in Shopify admin.

docs.title: Can I sell digital products with Theme InSpire?
docs.text: Yes! Theme InSpire supports all Shopify product types, including physical products, digital downloads, and services.

docs.title: Does Theme InSpire support product variants?
docs.text: Yes! You can create unlimited product variants (size, color, material, etc.) and display them as dropdowns, buttons, or image swatches.

docs.title: How do I enable customer reviews?
docs.text:
Theme InSpire works with review apps. Install a review app from the Shopify App Store such as:

  • Judge.me
  • Loox
  • Stamped.io

docs.title: How do I add a blog?
docs.text:
Blogs are built into Shopify: 1. In Shopify admin, go to Online Store > Blog posts 2. Click Create blog post 3. Add your content 4. Publish the post

The blog pages automatically use Theme InSpire's blog templates.

docs.title: General Questions
docs.text: Common questions about Theme InSpire and getting started.

docs.title: What is Theme InSpire?
docs.text: Theme InSpire is a modern, fully customizable Shopify theme designed by InStijl. It provides a flexible foundation for building beautiful online stores with powerful features and excellent performance.

docs.title: Do I need coding knowledge to use Theme InSpire?
docs.text: No! Theme InSpire is designed to be fully customizable through the Shopify theme editor without any coding. However, developers can extend the theme with custom code if needed.

docs.title: How do I install Theme InSpire?
docs.text: You can install the Theme from Shopify's Theme Store. See our Getting Started Guide for detailed instructions.

docs.title: Can I preview the theme before publishing?
docs.text: Yes! After uploading the theme, click Customize to preview and configure it before clicking Publish.

docs.title: Will I lose my content if I switch themes?
docs.text: No. Your products, collections, pages, and blog posts are stored in Shopify and will remain regardless of which theme you use. However, theme-specific settings and customizations will need to be reconfigured.

docs.title: Navigation & Menus
docs.text: Questions about setting up and managing your store navigation.

docs.title: How do I edit my navigation menu?
docs.text:
1. In Shopify admin, go to Online Store > Navigation
  2. Click on the menu you want to edit
  3. Add, remove, or reorder menu items
  4. Save changes

docs.title: How many menu items can I have?
docs.text: You can add up to 50 menu items per menu. For best UX, we recommend 5-10 main menu items.

docs.title: Can I create dropdown menus?
docs.text: Yes! Create a nested menu: 1. In Navigation, edit your main menu 2. Click Add menu item 3. Drag items to nest them under parent items 4. Sub-items will appear as dropdowns

docs.title: Performance & SEO
docs.text: Questions about theme performance, speed optimization, and search engine optimization.

docs.title: Is Theme InSpire optimized for speed?
docs.text: Yes! Theme InSpire follows Shopify's performance best practices including: - Lazy loading images - Optimized code - Minimal JavaScript - Efficient CSS

docs.title: Is Theme InSpire SEO-friendly?
docs.text: Yes! Theme InSpire includes: - Clean, semantic HTML - Proper heading structure - Schema.org structured data - Optimized meta tags - Mobile-friendly design

docs.title: Products & Collections
docs.text: Questions about managing products, collections, and related features.

docs.title: How do I change the number of products per row?
docs.text:
1. In theme editor, go to a collection page
  2. Click on the collection section
  3. Find the Products per row setting
  4. Choose 2, 3, 4, or 5 columns
  5. Click Save

docs.title: Updates & Support
docs.text: Questions about theme updates, support, and maintenance.

docs.title: How do I report a bug?
docs.text:
Contact InStijl support through the Need Help? page with details about the issue.

Include the following in your bug report: - Theme version - Store URL or preview link - Detailed description of the issue - Steps to reproduce - Screenshots or screen recordings - Browser and device information

docs.title: What browsers does Theme InSpire support?
docs.text: Theme InSpire supports all modern browsers: - Chrome (latest) - Firefox (latest) - Safari (latest) - Edge (latest) - Mobile browsers (iOS Safari, Chrome Mobile)

docs.title: Collection Page Setup Guide
docs.text: This guide will help you create effective collection pages that help customers discover and browse your products.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Collection pages organize your products into browsable categories. Well-designed collection pages should:

  • Display products in an organized, scannable layout
  • Provide filtering and sorting options
  • Show collection descriptions and imagery
  • Load quickly with many products
  • Work seamlessly on all devices

docs.title: Understanding Collection Pages
docs.text:
Theme InSpire provides several ways to display collections:

  1. Collection Template - Main collection page with product grid
  2. Collections Grid - Display multiple collections as cards
  3. Collections Carousel - Scrollable collection showcase
  4. Collection List - Directory of all collections

docs.title: Step 1: Configure the Collection Template
docs.text: The collection template is where customers browse products within a collection.

docs.title: Access Collection Template
docs.text:
1. Go to Online Store > Themes
  2. Click Customize
  3. Navigate to Collections > Default collection
  4. Configure the collection page settings

docs.title: Key Settings
docs.text:
Collection Header: - Show/hide collection title - Display collection description - Add collection image or banner - Configure header layout

Product Grid: - Set products per row (2, 3, 4, or 5 columns) - Configure mobile columns (1 or 2) - Set spacing between products - Enable/disable quick view

Filtering & Sorting: - Enable product filters (price, size, color, etc.) - Configure filter display (sidebar or above grid) - Enable sort options (featured, price, bestselling, etc.) - Set default sort order

Pagination: - Products per page - Pagination style (numbers or load more) - Enable infinite scroll

For detailed settings, see Collection Page Template Documentation.

docs.title: Step 2: Create and Organize Collections
docs.text: Before setting up collection pages, organize your products into collections.

docs.title: Create a Collection
docs.text:
1. In Shopify admin, go to Products > Collections
  2. Click Create collection
  3. Enter collection details:
  4. Title
  5. Description
  6. Image
  7. Collection type (manual or automated)

docs.title: Manual Collections
docs.text: Choose products individually: - Good for curated selections - Full control over product order - Requires manual updates

docs.title: Automated Collections
docs.text: Products are added based on rules: - Products automatically added/removed - Good for large inventories - Examples: "All products under $50", "Red shirts"

docs.title: Collection SEO
docs.text: Optimize each collection: - Write unique descriptions (at least 150 words) - Use relevant keywords naturally - Set page title and meta description - Add alt text to collection images

docs.title: Step 3: Design Collection Headers
docs.text: Create compelling collection headers.

docs.title: Collection Banners
docs.text:
1. In the collection template editor
  2. Enable collection image/banner
  3. Upload high-quality banner images (2400px x 600px recommended)
  4. Configure text overlay options
  5. Set banner height and positioning

docs.title: Collection Descriptions
docs.text:
Write effective collection descriptions:

Structure: 

## Collection Name

Brief introduction paragraph about the collection and what 
customers can expect to find.

### Why Shop This Collection
- Benefit 1
- Benefit 2
- Benefit 3

Additional context about the products, style, or use cases.

Tips: - Keep above-the-fold text concise - Use expandable sections for longer content - Include relevant keywords for SEO - Highlight unique selling points

docs.title: Step 4: Configure Product Display
docs.text: Optimize how products appear in collections.

docs.title: Product Card Settings
docs.text:
Configure what information displays on each product card:

  • Product image
  • Product title
  • Price (and compare-at price)
  • Vendor
  • Quick add button
  • Color/variant swatches
  • Badges (new, sale, out of stock)
  • Review stars

docs.title: Image Settings
docs.text:
• Aspect ratio: Square, portrait, or landscape
  • Hover effect: Second image on hover
  • Image crop: Cover or contain
  • Lazy loading: Enable for performance

docs.title: Grid Layout Options
docs.text:
Desktop: - 2 columns: Large product images, detailed view - 3 columns: Balanced (recommended) - 4 columns: More products visible - 5 columns: Maximum density

Mobile: - 1 column: Detailed view - 2 columns: Standard (recommended)

docs.title: Step 5: Set Up Filtering
docs.text: Help customers find products quickly with filters.

docs.title: Enable Product Filters
docs.text:
1. In Shopify admin, go to Online Store > Navigation > Filters
  2. Enable filters for your collections
  3. Choose filter types:
  4. Availability: In stock, out of stock
  5. Price: Price ranges
  6. Product type: Category filters
  7. Vendor: Brand filters
  8. Tags: Custom filters
  9. Options: Size, color, material (from variants)

docs.title: Configure Filter Display
docs.text: In theme customizer: - Filter position: Sidebar or horizontal - Filter style: Checkboxes, swatches, or list - Collapsible sections: Organize many filters - Active filters: Show selected filters - Clear all: Allow quick filter reset

docs.title: Filter Best Practices
docs.text:
• Don't overwhelm with too many filters
  • Use clear, descriptive filter labels
  • Show product count per filter option
  • Enable multi-select for same filter type
  • Test on mobile devices

docs.title: Step 6: Configure Sorting Options
docs.text: Let customers sort products their preferred way.

docs.title: Available Sort Options
docs.text:
• Featured: Your curated order
  • Best selling: By sales volume
  • Alphabetically (A-Z): By product title
  • Alphabetically (Z-A): Reverse alphabetical
  • Price (low to high): Cheapest first
  • Price (high to low): Most expensive first
  • Date (old to new): Oldest products first
  • Date (new to old): Newest products first

docs.title: Set Default Sort
docs.text: Choose the best default for each collection: - Featured: For curated collections - Best selling: For popular categories - Price (low to high): For budget-focused collections - Date (new to old): For "New arrivals" collections

docs.title: Step 7: Optimize Collection Page Performance
docs.text: Fast-loading pages improve conversion and SEO.

docs.title: Performance Tips
docs.text:
Images: - Compress product images - Use appropriate dimensions (800-1000px) - Enable lazy loading - Use modern formats (WebP with JPG fallback)

Product Count: - Limit products per page (24-48 recommended) - Use pagination or load more - Consider infinite scroll for mobile

Scripts: - Minimize third-party apps on collection pages - Defer non-critical JavaScript - Optimize filter interactions

Caching: - Collections are cached by Shopify - Avoid customer-specific content above the fold

docs.title: Step 8: Create a Collection List Page
docs.text: Help customers discover all your collections.

docs.title: Set Up List Collections Page
docs.text:
1. Create a page template for all collections
  2. In theme editor, go to Pages > Collection list
  3. Configure display:
  4. Grid columns
  5. Collection image size
  6. Show product count
  7. Show collection description

For detailed settings, see List Collections Documentation.

docs.title: Step 9: Add Collections to Homepage
docs.text: Drive traffic to collections from your homepage.

docs.title: Using Collections Grid
docs.text:
1. On homepage, add Collections Grid section
  2. Select featured collections
  3. Configure grid layout
  4. Add section heading and description

For detailed settings, see Collections Grid Documentation.

docs.title: Using Collections Carousel
docs.text:
1. On homepage, add Collections Carousel section
  2. Select collections to feature
  3. Configure carousel settings
  4. Enable autoplay (optional)

For detailed settings, see Collections Carousel Documentation.

docs.title: Step 10: Mobile Optimization
docs.text: Ensure collection pages work perfectly on mobile.

docs.title: Mobile Checklist
docs.text:
• Product images are crisp and clear
  • Text is readable without zooming
  • Filters are easily accessible
  • Sort dropdown works smoothly
  • Products load quickly
  • Add to cart is functional
  • Grid layout is appropriate (1-2 columns)
  • Images maintain aspect ratio

docs.title: Mobile-Specific Features
docs.text:
• Sticky filter/sort button
  • Slide-out filter drawer
  • Infinite scroll or load more
  • Quick view functionality
  • Optimized image sizes

docs.title: Organization
docs.text:
• Create logical collection hierarchy
  • Use clear, descriptive collection names
  • Limit number of top-level collections (5-10)
  • Use subcollections for large catalogs

docs.title: Content
docs.text:
• Write unique descriptions for each collection
  • Add high-quality collection images
  • Include keywords for SEO
  • Highlight collection benefits

docs.title: Navigation
docs.text:
• Add collections to main menu
  • Use mega menu for many collections
  • Include breadcrumbs
  • Link related collections

docs.title: User Experience
docs.text:
• Show relevant filters only
  • Provide clear sort options
  • Display product availability
  • Enable quick add to cart
  • Show variant options on cards

docs.title: Seasonal Collections
docs.text:
Create seasonal or promotional collections: - "Summer Sale" - "Holiday Gift Guide" - "New Arrivals"

Update featured collections regularly.

docs.title: Smart Collections
docs.text: Use automated collections with rules: - Products tagged "bestseller" - Products with inventory > 0 - Products added in last 30 days - Products in specific price ranges

docs.title: Collection Metafields
docs.text: Add custom data to collections: - Banner text overlay - Custom icons - Featured content - Related collections

docs.title: Monitoring Collection Performance
docs.text:
Track metrics to optimize:

  • Views: How many people visit
  • Bounce rate: Visitors who leave immediately
  • Products viewed: Engagement with products
  • Add to cart rate: How many add products
  • Conversion rate: Percentage who purchase

Use Shopify Analytics to identify: - Top-performing collections - Collections needing improvement - Effective filter combinations - Optimal product count per page

docs.title: Testing Your Collection Pages
docs.text:
Before launching:

  1. Test on multiple devices:
  2. Desktop (various browsers)
  3. Tablet (portrait and landscape)

  4. Mobile (iOS and Android)

  5. Test functionality:

  6. All filters work correctly
  7. Sorting changes product order
  8. Pagination loads properly
  9. Images load correctly

  10. Add to cart functions

  11. Check performance:

  12. Page load time under 3 seconds
  13. Images load progressively

  14. No layout shifts

  15. Verify SEO:

  16. Unique meta descriptions
  17. Proper heading structure
  18. Alt text on images
  19. Clean URLs

docs.text:

  • Homepage Setup - Design your homepage
  • Theme Settings - Explore all options

docs.text: For collection page questions, check our FAQ or visit Need Help? for support.

docs.title: Getting Started with Theme InSpire
docs.text: Welcome to Theme InSpire! This guide will help you get your Shopify store up and running with our theme.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before you begin, make sure you have:

  • A Shopify store
  • Basic understanding of Shopify's interface

docs.title: Step 1: Install the Theme
docs.text:
Install Theme Inspire for the Shopify Theme Store.

Install theme →

docs.title: Step 2: Configure Basic Settings
docs.text: After installing the theme, configure the essential settings:

docs.title: Theme Settings
docs.text:
1. Go to Online Store > Themes
  2. Click Customize on the Theme InSpire theme
  3. In the left sidebar, you'll find the theme settings

docs.title: Essential Configurations
docs.text:
• Logo: Upload your store logo
  • Colors: Set your brand colors
  • Typography: Choose your fonts
  • Favicon: Upload your site favicon

Check our theme settings reference to find more information on how to setup these essential configurations.

docs.title: Step 3: Set Up Your Header
docs.text:
Configure your navigation and header:

  1. In the theme editor, click on the Header section
  2. Configure your main navigation menu
  3. Set up announcement bar (if needed)
  4. Configure header layout options

For detailed header configuration, see the Header Main documentation.

docs.title: Step 4: Set Up Your Footer
docs.text:
Configure your footer content:

  1. In the theme editor, click on the Footer section
  2. Add footer menu links
  3. Configure social media links
  4. Add payment icons
  5. Set copyright information

For detailed footer configuration, see the Footer documentation.

docs.title: Step 5: Create Your Homepage
docs.text: Now you're ready to build your homepage! Follow our Homepage Setup Guide for detailed instructions.

docs.title: Next Steps
docs.text:
After completing the basic setup:

  • Homepage Setup Guide - Create an engaging homepage
  • Product Page Setup - Configure your product pages
  • Collection Page Setup - Set up collection pages
  • Theme Settings - Explore all theme settings

docs.title: Need Help?
docs.text: If you encounter any issues during setup, check our FAQ or visit the Need Help? page for support options.

docs.title: Homepage Setup Guide
docs.text: This guide will walk you through creating an engaging and effective homepage for your store using Theme InSpire.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
A well-designed homepage should:

  • Capture visitors' attention immediately
  • Showcase your best products or collections
  • Communicate your brand message
  • Guide visitors to key areas of your store

docs.title: Step 1: Plan Your Homepage Layout
docs.text:
Before you start building, plan your homepage structure. A typical homepage might include:

  1. Hero section (banner with call-to-action)
  2. Featured collections or products
  3. Brand story or unique value proposition
  4. Product carousels
  5. Testimonials or social proof
  6. Newsletter signup or contact form

docs.title: Step 2: Add a Hero Section
docs.text: The hero section is the first thing visitors see.

docs.title: Using the Hero Section
docs.text:
1. In the theme editor, click Add section
  2. Select Banners (Hero) from the list
  3. Configure the hero section:
  4. Upload a high-quality hero image or video
  5. Add compelling headline text
  6. Write a supporting subheadline
  7. Add a call-to-action button

Best Practices: - Use high-resolution images (at least 1920px wide) - Keep text concise and impactful - Use contrasting colors for buttons - Ensure mobile responsiveness

For detailed settings, see Hero Section Documentation.

docs.title: Step 3: Showcase Featured Collections
docs.text: Help visitors discover your products by featuring collections.

docs.title: Add Collections Grid
docs.text:
1. Click Add section
  2. Select Collections Grid
  3. Choose which collections to display
  4. Configure the grid layout (2, 3, or 4 columns)
  5. Add section heading and description

For detailed settings, see Collections Grid Documentation.

docs.title: Add Collections Carousel
docs.text:
Alternatively, use a carousel for more collections:

  1. Click Add section
  2. Select Collections Carousel
  3. Select collections to include
  4. Configure carousel settings (autoplay, speed, etc.)

For detailed settings, see Collections Carousel Documentation.

docs.title: Step 4: Display Featured Products
docs.text: Highlight your best-selling or featured products.

docs.title: Add Products Carousel
docs.text:
1. Click Add section
  2. Select Products Carousel
  3. Choose products to feature (manual or automatic selection)
  4. Configure display settings
  5. Set carousel behavior

For detailed settings, see Products Carousel Documentation.

docs.title: Add Products Grid
docs.text:
For a static grid layout:

  1. Click Add section
  2. Select Products Grid
  3. Select products or choose a collection
  4. Configure grid columns and spacing

For detailed settings, see Products Grid Documentation.

docs.title: Step 5: Add Brand Content
docs.text: Communicate your brand story and values.

docs.title: Using the Content Section
docs.text:
1. Click Add section
  2. Select Content Section
  3. Add your content:
  4. Heading and description
  5. Images or media
  6. Call-to-action buttons
  7. Custom styling

For detailed settings, see Content Section Documentation.

docs.title: Step 6: Build Trust with Testimonials
docs.text:
Social proof helps convert visitors into customers.

  1. Click Add section
  2. Select Testimonials
  3. Add customer testimonials:
  4. Customer name
  5. Testimonial text
  6. Star rating
  7. Customer photo (optional)

For detailed settings, see Testimonials Documentation.

docs.title: Step 7: Highlight Key Features
docs.text:
Show what makes your store special.

  1. Click Add section
  2. Select Icons/Features
  3. Add feature items:
  4. Icon
  5. Feature title
  6. Short description
  7. Common features: Free shipping, Returns, Support, Secure payment

For detailed settings, see Icons Section Documentation.

docs.title: Step 8: Add a Contact Form (Optional)
docs.text:
Make it easy for visitors to reach you.

  1. Click Add section
  2. Select Contact Form
  3. Configure form fields
  4. Set confirmation message
  5. Configure email notifications

For detailed settings, see Contact Form Documentation.

docs.title: Step 9: Arrange Section Order
docs.text:
Optimize the flow of your homepage:

  1. Hover over any section in the theme editor
  2. Use the drag handle (six dots) to reorder sections
  3. Test the flow from a visitor's perspective

Recommended Order: 1. Hero/Banner 2. Featured Collections 3. Featured Products 4. Brand Story/Content 5. Testimonials 6. Icons/Features 7. Newsletter/Contact

docs.title: Step 10: Preview and Publish
docs.text:
Before publishing your changes:

  1. Use the preview modes to test:
  2. Desktop view
  3. Tablet view
  4. Mobile view
  5. Check all links and buttons work
  6. Verify images load correctly
  7. Test forms (if added)
  8. Click Save to publish your changes

docs.title: Tips for an Effective Homepage
docs.text:
• Keep it focused: Don't overwhelm visitors with too many sections
  • Mobile-first: Ensure everything looks great on mobile devices
  • Fast loading: Optimize images for web (use compressed formats)
  • Clear CTAs: Make it obvious what you want visitors to do
  • Update regularly: Keep content fresh and relevant
  • A/B test: Try different layouts to see what converts best

docs.text:

  • Collection Page Setup - Set up collection pages
  • Theme Settings - Fine-tune global settings

docs.text: If you have questions about homepage setup, check our FAQ or visit Need Help? for support options.

docs.title: Product Page Setup Guide
docs.text: This guide will help you create optimized product pages that showcase your products effectively and drive conversions.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
Product pages are critical for converting visitors into customers. A well-designed product page should:

  • Display product information clearly
  • Show high-quality product images
  • Provide all necessary product details
  • Include social proof (reviews, ratings)
  • Suggest related products
  • Make purchasing easy and intuitive

docs.title: Understanding Product Page Structure
docs.text:
Theme InSpire product pages consist of several sections:

  1. Product Template - Main product information and purchase form
  2. Product Description - Detailed product information
  3. Product Specifications - Technical details and attributes
  4. Product Recommendations - Related or complementary products

docs.title: Step 1: Configure the Main Product Template
docs.text: The main product section displays essential product information.

docs.title: Access Product Template Settings
docs.text:
1. Go to Online Store > Themes
  2. Click Customize
  3. Navigate to Products > Default product
  4. Click on the Product information section

docs.title: Key Settings to Configure
docs.text:
Image Gallery: - Enable/disable image zoom - Set thumbnail position (left, bottom, or hidden) - Configure image aspect ratio - Enable video support

Product Information: - Show/hide SKU - Display vendor name - Enable dynamic checkout buttons - Configure variant selectors (dropdown or buttons)

Pricing Display: - Show compare-at prices - Display tax information - Show unit pricing

Add to Cart: - Customize button text - Enable quantity selector - Configure stock indicators

For detailed settings, see Product Page Template Documentation.

docs.title: Step 2: Set Up Product Description
docs.text: The description section provides detailed product information.

docs.title: Configure Product Description Section
docs.text:
1. In the product template editor, locate Product Description
  2. Configure layout options:
  3. Full width or contained
  4. Background color
  5. Padding and spacing

docs.title: Content Best Practices
docs.text:
When writing product descriptions:

  • Be specific: Include measurements, materials, and features
  • Use bullet points: Make key features scannable
  • Tell a story: Connect the product to customer needs
  • Include keywords: Help with SEO
  • Format for readability: Use headings, paragraphs, and lists

Example Structure: 

## About This Product
Brief introduction paragraph

## Key Features
- Feature 1
- Feature 2
- Feature 3

## How to Use
Step-by-step instructions

## Care Instructions
Maintenance information

For detailed settings, see Product Description Documentation.

docs.title: Step 3: Add Product Specifications
docs.text: Display technical details and specifications.

docs.title: Enable Product Specifications
docs.text:
1. In the product template, find Product Specifications
  2. Add specification blocks:
  3. Click Add block
  4. Select Specification item
  5. Add label and value

docs.title: Common Specifications
docs.text:
• Dimensions: Size, weight, volume
  • Materials: Fabric, components, composition
  • Care: Washing, maintenance instructions
  • Origin: Made in, brand information
  • Certifications: Quality marks, standards

docs.title: Using Metafields
docs.text:
For dynamic specifications:

  1. Set up product metafields in Shopify admin
  2. Link metafields to specification blocks
  3. Specifications will auto-populate per product

For detailed settings, see Product Specifications Documentation.

docs.title: Step 4: Enable Product Recommendations
docs.text: Show related products to increase average order value.

docs.title: Configure Recommendations
docs.text:
1. Locate Product Recommendations section
  2. Configure settings:
  3. Section heading
  4. Number of products to show
  5. Recommendation algorithm (related or complementary)
  6. Display style (carousel or grid)

docs.title: Recommendation Types
docs.text:
• Automatic: Shopify's AI suggests related products
  • Manual: Hand-pick related products using metafields
  • Collection-based: Show products from same collection

For detailed settings, see Product Recommendations Documentation.

docs.title: Step 5: Optimize Product Images
docs.text: High-quality images are crucial for product pages.

docs.title: Image Guidelines
docs.text:
Technical Requirements: - Minimum size: 2048 x 2048 pixels - File format: JPG or PNG - File size: Under 2MB (compressed) - Background: White or transparent preferred

Photography Tips: - Use multiple angles (front, back, sides, details) - Show product in use (lifestyle images) - Include size reference when relevant - Maintain consistent lighting and style - Show color variations accurately

docs.title: Upload Images
docs.text:
1. In Shopify admin, go to Products
  2. Select a product
  3. In the Media section, click Add media
  4. Upload images or drag to reorder
  5. Set alt text for SEO and accessibility

docs.title: Step 6: Configure Variants
docs.text: Set up product variants for different options.

docs.title: Create Variants
docs.text:
1. In product admin, go to Variants section
  2. Add option names (Size, Color, Material)
  3. Add option values (Small, Medium, Large)
  4. Set pricing per variant
  5. Upload variant-specific images

docs.title: Variant Display Options
docs.text: In theme customizer: - Dropdown: Compact, good for many options - Pills/Buttons: Visual, good for colors/sizes - Image swatches: Best for colors and patterns

docs.title: Step 7: Add Product Reviews (If Applicable)
docs.text: Social proof increases trust and conversions.

docs.title: Enable Reviews
docs.text:
1. Install a review app from Shopify App Store:
  2. Shopify Product Reviews (free)
  3. Judge.me
  4. Loox

  5. Stamped.io

  6. Configure review display on product pages

  7. Enable star ratings
  8. Set up review request emails

docs.title: Step 8: Configure Stock Indicators
docs.text: Help customers understand availability.

docs.title: Stock Settings
docs.text: In theme customizer: - Show inventory: Display stock levels - Low stock threshold: Warning when stock is low - Out of stock: Clear messaging - Pre-order: Enable for upcoming products

docs.title: Step 9: Mobile Optimization
docs.text: Ensure product pages work perfectly on mobile.

docs.title: Mobile Checklist
docs.text:
• Images are zoomable on mobile
  • Text is readable without zooming
  • Buttons are easily tappable
  • Variant selectors work smoothly
  • Add to cart button is always visible
  • Product information is organized clearly

docs.title: Preview on Mobile
docs.text:
1. In theme editor, use mobile preview mode
  2. Test the entire purchase flow
  3. Check image gallery functionality
  4. Verify button sizes and spacing

docs.title: Step 10: Test the Purchase Flow
docs.text: Before going live, test everything:

docs.title: Testing Checklist
docs.text:
• Add product to cart
  • Try different variants
  • Test quantity selector
  • Check dynamic checkout buttons
  • Verify pricing displays correctly
  • Test on multiple devices
  • Check page load speed
  • Verify all images load
  • Test with and without JavaScript

docs.title: Content
docs.text:
• Write clear, compelling product titles
  • Use descriptive, benefit-focused copy
  • Include size guides and dimension charts
  • Address common questions in description
  • Add trust signals (free shipping, returns)

docs.title: Design
docs.text:
• Keep layout clean and uncluttered
  • Use whitespace effectively
  • Ensure visual hierarchy is clear
  • Make CTA button prominent
  • Maintain brand consistency

docs.title: Performance
docs.text:
• Optimize image file sizes
  • Lazy load images below the fold
  • Minimize apps and scripts
  • Enable browser caching
  • Test page speed regularly

docs.title: SEO
docs.text:
• Write unique product descriptions
  • Use relevant keywords naturally
  • Optimize image alt text
  • Set up proper meta descriptions
  • Use structured data markup

docs.title: Cross-selling
docs.text: Set up product bundles or frequently bought together suggestions using apps or metafields.

docs.title: Size Guides
docs.text: Add size guide popups or accordions to help customers choose correctly.

docs.title: Product Videos
docs.text: Upload product videos to showcase features and usage.

docs.title: 360° Product Views
docs.text: Use apps to add interactive product rotation.

docs.title: Monitoring Performance
docs.text:
Track your product page performance:

  • Conversion rate: Percentage of visitors who purchase
  • Bounce rate: Visitors who leave without action
  • Time on page: How long visitors engage
  • Add to cart rate: Percentage who add to cart
  • Cart abandonment: Who adds but doesn't purchase

Use Shopify Analytics or Google Analytics to monitor these metrics.

docs.text:

  • Homepage Setup - Return to homepage configuration
  • Theme Settings - Explore all theme options

docs.text: For questions about product page setup, check our FAQ or visit Need Help? for support.
